sources.entry: gymnasium - A standard API for reinforcement learning environments with popular reference environments (gym successor).

summary.one_liner: Gym is an open-source Python library providing a standard API and a set of reference environments for developing and comparing reinforcement learning algorithms, now superseded by Gymnasium and no longer receiving updates.
summary.what_it_does: The README states that Gym provides a standard API for communication between reinforcement learning algorithms and environments, plus a standard set of environments compliant with that API. Environments are exposed as Python env classes, created with gym.make (example uses "CartPole-v1") and driven with reset, step, and close calls. The base install is pip install gym; extra environment families such as Atari or MuJoCo are installed as optional extras (gym[atari], gym[all], gym[mujoco]). Environment IDs carry version suffixes (e.g. _v0, _v4) that increase when changes could affect learning results. The README also points to related libraries: CleanRL, Tianshou, RLlib, and PettingZoo for multi-agent environments.
use_cases: training reinforcement learning agents on standard environments
benchmarking RL algorithms against a common API
how_to_run: observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step(action)
stack: pip extras for optional environment families
notable: Defines the de facto standard reset/step API for RL environments
Optional extras install dependencies per environment family
Gym is superseded by Gymnasium, a drop-in replacement (import gymnasium as gym)
caveats: The maintainers have moved all development to Gymnasium and Gym will not receive future updates
Officially supports Python 3.7 to 3.10 on Linux and macOS only; Windows is not officially supported
Legacy MuJoCo environments depending on mujoco-py are unmaintained
